lines.text: This is ATLAS, a personal operating system.
It puts your whole life on one route: money, tasks, goals and career.
Today picks your next move, and Money keeps every peso in one total.
Tasks fit the plan to your day, and goals update as milestones get done.
Ask the Analyst about your records, or capture a whole day in one message.
Career tracks every application, and the Timeline keeps it all in order.
ATLAS. Designed and built by Keith Vergara.
